## Changing management companies, without the disruption.

For most boards, the switch is the biggest worry. Here is how we handle it.

### Review
We meet your board and review the declaration, budget, and current contracts.

### Propose
You receive a written scope and a flat monthly fee for your property.

### Transition
We coordinate the transfer of records, funds, and vendors from your prior manager.

### Manage
Monthly financials, steady communication, and ongoing building oversight.

## Questions boards ask first.

### What does CenterPoint Association Management do?
CenterPoint Association Management manages condominium, HOA, and townhome associations in Chicago and the surrounding suburbs: financial management, maintenance and vendor coordination, board and governance support, and resale disclosures. We do not manage rental apartments or tenant leasing.

### Where does CenterPoint work?
Across 29 Chicago neighborhoods, from Rogers Park to Hyde Park, and 14 North Shore and nearby suburbs, from Evanston to Lake Forest. See all [service areas](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/service-areas).

### How much does condo or HOA management cost?
Management starts at $20 per unit per month, quoted as a flat monthly fee based on your association's size and scope. It is never a percentage of your budget. See [pricing](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/pricing).

### How do we switch management companies?
Most transitions take 30 to 60 days after notice to your current manager. We handle records, banking, vendors, and owner communication. See [choosing management](https://www.centerpointmgmt.com/blog/topic/choosing-association-management) or call [773.728.0652](tel:+17737280652).
